name: transcribe
title: Transcribe audio and video
description: Turns the speech in an audio or video file into text (Arabic, English and about 100 other languages, detected automatically), and saves it as a .txt transcript, .srt subtitles and .json. Use it whenever the user wants a transcript, subtitles, minutes or a summary of a recording, lecture, meeting or video.
setupSize: about 2.3 GB, once: Python with its speech libraries (about 0.7 GB) and the turbo speech model (1.6 GB)

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code to use instead of detecting it (ar, en, fr ...). Leave empty to detect it.

parameters.name: timestamps
parameters.description: Start every paragraph of the .txt with its time, e.g. [00:12:30].

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Speech model. turbo (1.6 GB) is accurate and fast and is installed by the setup; small (0.5 GB) is quicker but weaker on Arabic; medium (1.5 GB) and large-v3 (3.1 GB) download on first use.

parameters.name: hotwords
parameters.description: Names and terms the recording uses, comma separated, so they are spelled right.

parameters.name: output_folder
parameters.description: Folder for the transcript files. Default: Documents\NexusShell\transcribe.
